title: A Interior for the Postcards
author: Coral Halloran
blurb: Tamsin Eastwick, a former prodigy returning to the conservatory as a janitor, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. But when a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must forgive the stranger in the old photographs before the mother's memory goes entirely.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
